dispute_ticket.description: I was quoted S$19.80 but charged S$21.40 and I want the S$1.60 back. Also, when I took my card holder back from him at the end he kept hold of my hand and stroked my arm, then said I have such soft skin and he would love to see me again. I pulled away and got out quickly. I do not want to deal with this driver again.

app_events.details: Upfront base fare quoted S$19.80, ERP charged on top at actual cost.
ERP gantry on AYE crossed, S$1.60.
Trip completed; fare S$21.40 (base S$19.80 + ERP S$1.60).

fare_basis.text: States how this trip's fare is set: a fixed upfront base fare, with ERP charged on top.

erp_charge_per_gantry_crossed.text: ERP is borne by the rider. A gantry may be charged at this SGD amount only if it appears as an erp_gantry_crossed event in app_events for this trip.

personal_approaches_prohibited.text: Governs a driver's or rider's personal approaches to the other party. A true value means pressing the other party for contact details, personal invitations, gifts or remarks about their body or private life are not allowed on a Ryde trip.

refund_at_ryde_discretion.text: Governs refunds on this trip. A true value means Ryde may refund beyond the strict rules where the facts justify it. It does not create a right to a refund.

expected_outcome.reason: The fare part on its face fails: the base S$19.80 quoted at 18:02 plus one ERP gantry of S$1.60 at 18:19:30 equals the S$21.40 charged. But the rider also describes the driver holding her hand and stroking her arm at hand-back and making remarks about her skin and wanting to see her again. There is no chat to check, so only the ticket tells it. Unwanted physical contact and personal advances by the driver are a safety matter that Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 s5.2 says AI may prepare but a person must decide, so no automated verdict or refund on the fare either.
